Key points from the transcript:
1. The ballot shortage issue wasn't just in Songpa-gu but also occurred in other places like Gangseo-gu
2. Local government officials handle all election support work (voting station setup, management, etc.), not election commission staff
3. There was no manual for handling ballot shortages - the education for managers didn't cover this scenario
4. In Gangseo-gu, they handled it relatively well by bringing spare ballots from the election commission, but this was improvised, not following a manual
5. The system has problems - local election commissions are understaffed (11-15 people), so they rely on local government officials
